_comment: Call playbooks seed (WIL-129): per-hotline required-info definitions and IVR flow knowledge. Copied to data/call_playbooks.json on first run. KEY/VALUE SEPARATION: this library stores only WHAT is needed (field definitions, public IVR knowledge) - never actual values. Real values (PIN, ZIP, ...) live in number_profiles.json task_package.verification. Keep entries free of any digit sequence that could be a real value; hotline numbers belong only in the numbers field.

ivr_notes.zh: 语音 IVR（Ada）是关键词分类器：对是非/分类式反问只用最短词回答（"No."/"Yes."/"Representative"），绝不解释、绝不说过渡句——长句会被误判。要求转人工反复用单词 "Representative" 或 "Agent"。听到按键菜单立即用键盘按键，按键优先于说话；绝不按未被菜单点名的数字。核身顺序：先四位 PIN、再激活 ZIP，全部通过后才进转人工排队。IVR 菜单播报时静默听完；排队/等待音乐期间保持完全静默、绝不挂断。客服人工时段约为周一至周五 9am-9pm、周六 12pm-9pm（东部时间），时段外只有自助菜单。
ivr_notes.en: The speech IVR (Ada) is a keyword classifier: answer yes/no or category questions with the shortest token only ("No."/"Yes."/"Representative") - never explain, never use transition phrases; long sentences get misclassified. To reach a human, repeat the single word "Representative" or "Agent". When a keypad menu is offered, press keys immediately - pressing takes priority over speaking; never press a digit the menu did not announce. Verification order: four-digit PIN first, then the activation ZIP; only after both does the agent-transfer queue begin. Listen silently through menu announcements; stay completely silent during hold music and never hang up. Live agents are available roughly Mon-Fri 9am-9pm and Sat 12pm-9pm ET; outside those hours only self-service menus respond.

source.en: Verified on a real device (2026-08-18, WIL-120 611 drills 1a/1b/1c)
